purpose: Determine whether the same exact-origin, independently evaluated real-SWAP participant response at the rejected C2b rain forcing changes as only the trial duration is shortened.

fixed_conditions.origin: After accepted C2a publication at t=0.001 day; committed revision and interface ledger count are one.
fixed_conditions.participants: All 50, individually and discarded; no MODFLOW/application-service publication is implied.

gates.fresh_process_replay: Two independent executions must produce byte-identical JSON, including all participant/duration rows and the unchanged-state proof.

interpretation_limit: A shorter-duration isolated participant trial that completes is only a necessary component response observation. It does not show that the full native 50-column coupling service publishes at that duration or that a stable rain ramp reaches the target.
